hooks.name: Validate schema and seed report on save
hooks.description: On save of schema/report.schema.json, validate the schema itself and validate seed/report.json against it. Read-only.

action.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0
.venv/bin/python3.12 -c "import json, jsonschema; schema = json.load(open('schema/report.schema.json')); jsonschema.Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema); report = json.load(open('seed/report.json')); jsonschema.validate(report, schema); print('Schema valid. seed/report.json validates OK.')"
